scenario.title: Battle of Korytsa
intro.text:
BATTLE OF KORYTSA - 16 NOV 1940

Morava Mountains, Albania

The Italian attack could be stopped along the entire front! Now we will take the initiative and launch an offensive on the eastern flank of the front. Target of the attack is traffic point Korytsa in Albania. A victory will strengthen the morale of our troops and our nation in general.

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE The unit occupying the town Korytsa gets the chance of gain experience!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-0-0-briliant.speaker: Konstantinos Davakis
line.reaction-0-0-briliant.text: Vovousa held and the Italian column recoiled before it could threaten Metsovo. The cavalry is already closing on roads the enemy believed were behind him.
line.reaction-0-1-victory-tactical.text: The Italians were stopped in the Pindus, but the battalions arrived at the next assembly area by different roads and with different numbers. We won the pass; now we count its price.
line.callback-0.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-0.text: I argued for a reserve in the Pindus. Your continuous line held. I have stopped calling a gap harmless simply because a battalion waits behind it.
line.callback-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-1.text: The reserve at Pindus arrived where the map had failed. Since then the men have trusted a moving company more than a perfect line drawn at headquarters.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.earned-decision.text: Lieutenant Karras has brought forty-three riders out of the Pindus with both radios working. He is outside asking whether he still has a troop or merely forty-three useful replacements.
line.earned-decision.choice.keep-pindus-: Keep the Pindus cavalry screen as a separate detachment.
Add an experienced seven-strength cavalry detachment to the core.
line.earned-decision.choice.spread-pindu: Return the riders and distribute their mountain practice.
Give infantry 10 experience and fully refuel the core instead of adding a unit.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.earned-a-response.text: Karras keeps the troop. He has already found three roads the map section insists are footpaths.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.earned-b-response.text: Strike the troop from the return. Its riders go to the battalions as guides, and Karras reports to the route office. He will hate the desk.
line.scene-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-0.text: The refugee carts are coming down the Korytsa road axle to axle. One driver says the Italians left the first village; the next swears they put guns in its schoolyard.
line.scene-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-1.text: Both reports can be true. Their rear guard is moving while we argue, and the road forks twice before the city.
line.scene-2.speaker: Alexandros Papagos
line.scene-2.text: Athens wants Korytsa on tomorrow's front page. I want the junction before the Italians can make a second line. Those are not quite the same order.
line.decision.speaker: Alexandros Papagos
line.decision.text: Will you drive on the city now, or clear the lateral roads first? Choose; I will answer for the timetable.
line.decision.choice.drive-on-korytsa.te: Give the best ammunition and transport to a direct drive on Korytsa.
line.decision.choice.drive-on-korytsa.hi: Spend 50 prestige, give infantry 15 experience, and fully rearm the core.
line.decision.choice.secure-the-villages: Clear the two villages and make the road safe before approaching Korytsa.
Restore the core to at least eight strength, fully refuel and rearm it, and give reconnaissance 10 experience.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: City first. Very well. I shall give the lead battalion the trucks and ask the quartermaster to perform miracles behind it.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.choice-a-1.text: No miracles. Scouts stay on both forks, and a company turns back the instant a gun opens on the supply road. The rest do not stop.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Alexandros Papagos
line.choice-b-0.text: You are giving their command another day to recover. If the city hardens, nobody in Athens will remember why the villages seemed urgent.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-b-1.text: The battalions will remember. We clear the forks, post traffic guards, and reach Korytsa with their breakfast and shells still behind them.
